measurements.sensor: Release binding tests, authenticated APIs, and in-app browser DOM/geometry
measurements.raw_evidence: Five fixed scenes rendered; P-RDDMP-UPGRADE displayed 1/5 configured and another project displayed 0/5; published candidates require real deployments; the 857px table had 857px scroll width and no console errors.

measurements.sensor: Release submission tests plus authenticated HTTP and database probes
measurements.raw_evidence: An unbound submission returned 409 and created no approval round; configured REGULAR submission entered IN_REVIEW; partial scene configuration remained valid.

measurements.sensor: Cross-module integration tests plus two real release submissions around a rebind
measurements.raw_evidence: SQ-202608-001 retained deployed Flow A, while SQ-202608-002 submitted after rebinding froze deployed Flow B; frontend request contracts do not expose a selectable workflow definition.
limitation: Approval completion was not required to prove binding immutability.

measurements.sensor: Binding service/security tests, authenticated API conflict probes, history API, and browser history display
measurements.raw_evidence: Bind, rebind, unbind, required reasons, before/after history, operator identity, project isolation, and stale row-version 409 all worked; browser showed the persisted operation time but it was approximately eight hours behind Asia/Shanghai.
limitation: The application currently serializes timezone-less LocalDateTime values and the database container session uses UTC.

measurements.sensor: Workflow lifecycle tests plus authenticated archive/delete API probes
measurements.raw_evidence: Actively bound archive returned 409, formerly published draft deletion returned 409, and a pure never-published draft deletion returned 200.

feedback.expected: Audit operation times display according to the platform business timezone Asia/Shanghai.
feedback.observed: The binding history displayed 2026-08-17 08:50:52 for an operation performed around 16:50 local time.
feedback.reproduction: Create or update a binding while MySQL runs with a UTC session, then open approval workflow configuration history.
feedback.evidence: Authenticated browser DOM showed 2026-08-17 08:50:52; application-local.yml declares serverTimezone=Asia/Shanghai but V43 and many platform migrations rely on database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP while APIs expose LocalDateTime without an offset.
feedback.sensor_limit: The exact impact across every existing platform table was not exhaustively sampled.
feedback.causal_hypothesis: The JDBC connection timezone parses values as Shanghai but does not force the MySQL session timezone, so CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is evaluated in the UTC container session and loses zone context in DATETIME/LocalDateTime.
feedback.correction_check: Define one platform timestamp contract, configure the database session and JSON serialization consistently, then verify binding history and representative existing module timestamps around a known instant.

disturbances.event: Legacy published workflow seed rows had no Flowable deployment.
disturbances.evidence: Initial runtime submission failed; deployed-candidate filtering was added and the focused 3-test suite plus two real submissions passed.

coverage_gaps: Production authorization roles and migration duration were not sampled.
Project management, physical subsystem, and delivery-unit source modules are not yet available and remain behind the approved mock interfaces.
Platform-wide timestamp normalization remains outside this module-specific implementation.
